title: Snoozer Quinn's unreleased recordings and Bing Crosby
summary: Wiggs says Snoozer Quinn's twelve sides were never released, and that Bing Crosby's enquiry found Quinn already dead.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: I was about to say at that time Snoozer had never been recorded but Snoozer hadn't been recorded. But Snoozer has never been recorded except the 12 sides that I have of his. They've never been released. The 12 sides that I have have never been released yet.
The four sides are all that came out.
Yeah, I put out four sides myself.
Remember that business in the paper about four or five months ago? Did you see that when people, somebody mentioned Snoozer Quinn?
Oh, Bing Crosby, the great almighty God
something about Snoozer Quinn and everybody fell on their face trying to get information out to Bing Crosby. What happened to Snoozer Quinn? He was dead even.
Yeah, they didn't even know he was dead. Oh, no, no.
Very few people knew he was dead.
